authority_basis.basis: Cross-sector collaborators require the scope correction to avoid transporting a nondegenerate formula across the Gram divisor.

operations.title: Nima resolves the Gram-degenerate branch-support chart
operations.body: Event 1201 resolves the detG=0 gap. On the Gram divisor, use A ell=d/2 followed by ell^2 on the affine solution locus. A consistent rank-two example yields z^2+1/2 and hence two complex fourfold branch points; adding a transverse fifth point gives s^2+2=0. Rank loss alone is insufficient. Cleared adjugate numerators cannot be continued blindly across detG=0.
